title: Uncovering Regional Defaults from Photorealistic Forests in Text-to-Image Generation with DALL·E 2

bias_targets.methodology: Generating images of a geographically varying object class (forests) using region-hierarchical prompts in DALL-E 2, computing cross-level image similarity using Mean Squared Error (MSE) and Structural Similarity Index Measure (SSIM) to identify implicit regional defaults, and comparing these defaults against real-world spatial statistics.
